{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Confirm only two channels exist
assert len(data['channel'].unique()) == 2, "There are only two channels, not three. The premise is false."

# Check revenue type
print(f"Revenue dtype: {data['revenue'].dtype}")

# It's object (string) — now parse it
# Remove commas and cast to float
data['revenue'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders and exclude QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
valid_data = data[(data['status'] == 'completed') & (data['revenue'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute total revenue per channel
channel_revenue = valid_data.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()

# Print the total revenue per channel
print("Total revenue per channel:")
print(channel_revenue)

# Identify the channel with highest revenue
max_channel = channel_revenue.loc[channel_revenue['revenue'].idxmax(), 'channel']
max_revenue = channel_revenue['revenue'].max()

# Print the max channel and revenue
print(f"Channel with highest revenue: {max_channel}")
print(f"Highest total revenue: {max_revenue}")"}
